thread:
Devon: folks — heads up, last-minute flight. Need someone to take primary for my 18:00-02:00 window. There's an active low-sev pager for embed-svc; I'll hand over now. :airplane:

incident-bot: Pager #4321 | embeds-cluster | cpu spike on node-7. Severity: P2. Link: https://redwood.ops/incidents/4321

Priya: I can take primary for that window. @Jules will you shadow/secondary?

Devon: Thanks @Priya. Current impact: 95p latency for embeddings ~2.1s for a subset of customers (segment A). Dash: https://dash/embeds/latency?range=15m. Quick debug: restarted one pod earlier but HPA didn't trigger. Runbook excerpt below.

Devon: ```bash
# scale up replicas
kubectl -n prod scale deploy/embed-svc --replicas=4
# verify pods
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=embed-svc
# check redis kv hitrate
redis-cli -h redis-prod INFO | grep keyspace
```

Devon: Also check node CPU on node-7 and consider cordon/drain if noisy. If scaling doesn't help within 15m escalate per policy.

Jules: I can shadow. @Priya confirm you have cluster creds + KMS access? I can take on-call console duties if needed.

Priya: Confirmed, I have cluster + KMS. I'll take primary. Starting manual scale now.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Manual scale applied for embed-svc -> replicas 4 (ok). HPA status: target not reached.

Priya: Scaled to 4. Also going to flush a small redis prefix to force a regen of cold prefixes (low risk).

Priya: ```bash
# delete embeds transient keys (run carefully)
redis-cli -h redis-prod EVAL "return redis.call('del', unpack(redis.call('keys', ARGV[1])))" 0 'embeds:*'
```

incident-bot: If 95p latency not improved in 15m, page SRE-oncall per escalation policy.

Priya: 95p down to ~1.05s after scale + cache flush. Continuing to watch for 30m. Updating rotation: Devon off 18:00-02:00, Priya primary, Jules secondary (shadow). I'll update the rotation page.

Devon: Thanks all — added a short handoff note to the ticket and calendar. I'll be reachable by DM if needed but likely offline at the gate. :thumbsup:

Jules: Shadow acked. I'll watch metrics/dash and be ready to take over if another page fires. Leaving a one-line checklist here: restart pods if OOM, scale further if CPU sustained >80%, open infra ticket for noisy node.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: HPA target updated to 70% CPU, current avg 45% — autoscaler healthy.

Priya: Closing the swap thread — rotation updated (https://rotations.redwood/schedules). Latency stable, keeping 30m watch then mark stable in incident. Thanks everyone.

Devon: Appreciate it, safe handoff.
